hero_intro: Drop a batch of images. tinyz compresses them in a background thread, so your files never leave this device.
dropzone_note: PNG, JPG, WEBP up to 150 MB each
preview_tips_body: Drag the center handle to compare, use zoom to inspect details, and fullscreen for a larger view.
result_tips_body: Review processed files here, download a single result or the full set as ZIP, and clear the queue when you want to start over.
clear_queue_body: This removes all processed images and previews from this session. This cannot be undone.
local_tip: Your images are processed locally. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
compression_error: Choose PNG, JPEG, or WebP images to begin.
file_too_large: Images over {limit} MB is not allowed.
